title: Ptolemy Complex Proof OQ-01: Equality Case and Same-Ray Converse

problemStatement.formal: For complex points z1, z2, z3, z4, prove that equality in the triangle-inequality proof of Ptolemy is equivalent to a same-ray condition and implies proportionality of the opposite-side product vectors.
problemStatement.plain: Backfills metadata for the equality-case direction of the complex proof of Ptolemy's theorem. The Lean file proves that Ptolemy equality is governed by the same-ray condition and yields the expected proportionality statement.

The complex-number proof reduces the equality case to a precise triangle-inequality equality condition.
The converse/equality metadata helps distinguish the proved algebraic condition from broader concyclicity goals.

proven: `ptolemy_equality_iff_sameRay` proves the equivalence between Ptolemy equality and the same-ray condition in the complex proof setup.
